extraction_note: Test identities and ordering follow the 17 numbered sections of the OIML R 76-2:2007 test report format. Procedures, severities and tolerances are taken from OIML R 76-1:2006 Annexes A and B. Applicability, load points and pass rules are encoded so the application can build its own data-entry forms.

tolerance_kinds.MPE: Compared against the maximum permissible error for the applied load (mpe-bands.json).
tolerance_kinds.SIGNIFICANT_FAULT: The difference between the indication with and without the disturbance shall not exceed 1 e, OR the instrument shall detect and react to a significant fault.
tolerance_kinds.ABSOLUTE_E: Compared against a fixed multiple of e stated in the rule.
tolerance_kinds.FUNCTIONAL: All functions shall operate as designed; judged by observation, recorded as a checklist verdict.
tolerance_kinds.OBSERVATION: Recorded for information; no automatic verdict.

tests.title: Weighing performance
tests.clause_in: Seventh Schedule, Heading A, Part II, para 9
tests.summary: Determine the error of indication at a series of loads, increasing then decreasing, after setting to zero.

load_points.rule: At least five loads including Min, Max and the loads at which the mpe changes band.

inputs.label: Additional weights ΔL
inputs.help: Sum of e/10 weights added until the indication increased by one increment.

notes: The rounding error shall be eliminated if d > 0.2 e (3.5.3.2).
The error of any single weighing result shall by itself not exceed the mpe (3.6).

tests.title: Temperature effect on no-load indication
tests.summary: Set to zero, change to the highest and lowest specified temperatures and 5 °C if applicable, and determine the change in zero indication.

tolerance.rule: The change in zero indication shall not exceed 0.5 e per 1 °C for class I instruments, or per 5 °C for other classes, between any two consecutive temperatures of the test.

notes: Preloading is not allowed before these measurements.
Automatic zero-setting or zero-tracking shall not be in operation.
May be performed together with the static temperature test A.5.3.1.

tests.title: Eccentricity
tests.summary: Apply the load in turn to the centre and to each quarter segment of the load receptor.

load_points.help: Approximately one third of Max, unless the instrument's own rules dictate otherwise.

positions.gt_4_supports_rule: Apply the load over each support on an area of the same order as 1/n of the load receptor surface, where n is the number of points of support. Where two supports are too close, double the load and distribute it over twice the area on both sides of the axis connecting them.
positions.special_receptors: Tanks, hoppers and similar receptors follow A.4.7.3.

tests.title: Discrimination
tests.summary: Confirm that a small additional load produces an unambiguous change of one scale interval.

load_points.help: Three different loads, e.g. Min, ½ Max and Max.

digital.procedure: Place the load plus about 10 additional weights of d/10. Remove them successively until the indication falls unambiguously by one actual scale interval to I − d. Replace one additional weight, then gently add 1.4 d; the indication shall become I + d.

analog.procedure: Place or remove an extra load, not less than 1 mg, while the instrument is at equilibrium. The equilibrium mechanism shall assume a different position of equilibrium.

tolerance.rule: The indication after adding 1.4 d shall equal I + d, i.e. one actual scale interval above the initial indication.

tests.title: Sensitivity (non-self-indicating instruments)
tests.summary: With the instrument oscillating normally, apply an extra load equal to the mpe for the applied load (not less than 1 mg) and measure the permanent displacement of the indication.

load_points.help: A minimum of two different loads, e.g. zero and Max.

tolerance.rule: A permanent displacement of the indication shall be observed.

tests.title: Repeatability
tests.summary: Weigh the same load repeatedly and compare the spread of results against the mpe for that load.

type_approval.weighings_rule: 10 weighings per series if Max < 1 000 kg, otherwise at least 3.

verification.weighings_rule: 3 weighings for classes III and IIII, 6 weighings for classes I and II.

tolerance.rule: The difference between the results of several weighings of the same load shall not be greater than the absolute value of the mpe for that load.

notes: Automatic zero-setting or zero-tracking shall be in operation during the test.
Reset to zero between weighings if a zero deviation occurs; the true zero need not be determined.

tests.title: Time-dependence (creep and zero return)
tests.summary: Observe how the indication changes while a load close to Max remains applied, and how zero recovers afterwards.

creep.procedure: Load close to Max. Read as soon as the indication stabilises, then note the indication over four hours. Temperature shall not vary more than 2 °C.
creep.early_termination: May be terminated after 30 minutes if the indication differs by less than 0.5 e during the first 30 minutes and the difference between 15 and 30 minutes is less than 0.2 e.

zero_return.procedure: Determine the deviation in the zero indication before and after loading close to Max for half an hour. For multiple range instruments continue reading zero for 5 minutes after stabilisation.
notes: Automatic zero-setting or zero-tracking shall not be in operation.

tests.title: Stability of equilibrium
tests.summary: Examine the documented stable-equilibrium criteria and confirm that printing or data storage occurs only at stable equilibrium.
checklist: The basic principle, function and criteria for stable equilibrium are described in detail.
All adjustable and non-adjustable parameters of the stable-equilibrium function are described.
Printing or data storage takes place only when equilibrium is stable.
The indication is stable before and after the operation.

tests.title: Tilting
tests.summary: Tilt the instrument within the specified limits, at no load and loaded, and determine the change of indication.

tests.title: Tare, or weighing test with tare
tests.summary: Verify the accuracy of tare setting, the weighing performance with tare applied, and the tare weighing device.

weighing_with_tare.rule: The mpe applies to the net value for every possible tare load, except preset tare values.

tare_weighing_device.rule: The mpe for a tare weighing device is the same, for any tare value, as that of the instrument for the same load.

tests.title: Warm-up time
tests.summary: After at least 8 hours disconnected, switch on, set to zero and determine the error at zero and near Max at intervals.

tolerance.rule: Every measurement after 5, 15 and 30 minutes shall be corrected for the zero error at that time and shall be within the mpe.

notes: Disconnect from the supply for at least 8 hours before the test.
For class I instruments observe the operating manual's provisions for time after connection.

tests.title: Voltage variations
tests.summary: Subject the instrument to the voltage limits of its power supply and confirm all indications stay within the mpe.

ac_mains.allowable: All functions shall operate as designed. All indications within the mpe.
ac_mains.note: For a three-phase supply the variations apply to each phase successively.

external_or_plugin.allowable: All functions operate as designed or the indication switches off. All indications within the mpe.

non_rechargeable_battery.allowable: All functions operate as designed or the indication switches off. All indications within the mpe.

road_vehicle_battery.upper: 16 V for a 12 V battery; see A.5.4.4 for 24 V

tests.title: Electrical disturbances
tests.summary: Expose the instrument to electromagnetic disturbances and confirm no significant fault occurs.

tests.title: Damp heat, steady state
tests.not_applicable_to: Class I instruments, and class II instruments where e < 1 g.
tests.summary: Expose to constant temperature and relative humidity and repeat the weighing test at each stage.

stages.label: Reference, conditioned
stages.temperature: 20 °C or the mean of the range

stages.label: Return to reference
stages.temperature: 20 °C or the mean of the range

load_points.help: At least five different test loads, or simulated loads.

tolerance.rule: All functions shall operate as designed and all indications shall be within the mpe.

tests.title: Span stability
tests.summary: Observe the variation of error at a load near Max over an extended period spanning the other performance tests.
tests.duration_rule: 28 days or the period necessary for the performance tests, whichever is shorter.
tests.interval_rule: Between ½ day and 10 days, fairly evenly distributed.

load_points.help: The same test weights shall be used throughout.

tests.stabilisation: At least 5 hours after switch-on, and at least 16 hours after the temperature and damp heat tests.

tests.title: Endurance
tests.summary: Apply and remove a load of about 50 % of Max 100 000 times, with a weighing test before and after.
sequence: Weighing test per A.4.4.1 before the endurance loading, to obtain the intrinsic error.
100 000 loading and unloading cycles at about 50 % of Max.
Weighing test per A.4.4.1 after completion, to determine the durability error due to wear and tear.
notes: The endurance test shall be performed after all other tests.
The force applied shall not exceed that attained in a normal loading operation.

tests.title: Examination of the construction of the instrument
tests.summary: Compare the construction with the documentation, and examine metrological characteristics, descriptive markings, stamping and securing.

checklist.item: Construction agrees with the submitted documentation
Descriptive markings present, legible and indelible
Administrative examination of the application complete

tests.title: Clause-by-clause compliance checklist
tests.clause_r76_1: Whole Recommendation; Annex G for software-controlled instruments
tests.summary: Clause-by-clause confirmation of technical and metrological compliance, including software requirements.
